visibleLabel: visible (display condition — decision is hidden when not met)
flagChainHintPrefix: : make sure that flag is set via
flagChainHintSuffix: somewhere — a focus completion_reward / an event immediate / the starting country flag list. Otherwise the decision is never visible.
removeEffectLabel: remove_effect (effect after completion — days_remove days later)
cwtoolTip: your script is checked against 2000+ vanilla modifiers.
missionModeHint: (mission mode · pair with days_mission_timeout + activation + timeout_effect)
activationLabel: activation (trigger that auto-activates the mission · leave empty to fire from script)
timeoutEffectLabel: timeout_effect (runs when the mission times out · ≠ cancel_effect)
stateTargetHint: FROM = chosen state · empty = not state-targeted
priorityHint: UI display order · higher priority sorts first
customCostTextHint: loc yml key · use together with custom_cost_trigger
targetRootTriggerLabel: target_root_trigger (ROOT perspective · the player country must satisfy it)
targetTriggerLabel: target_trigger (FROM perspective · evaluated for each target separately)
customCostTriggerLabel: custom_cost_trigger (custom cost gate · must be met to select)
nameHint: The name players read on the decision card. Leave it empty and a new decision shows its raw id; a decision that reuses a vanilla id keeps the vanilla name.
effectTooltipHint: Plain-language tooltip for the complete_effect. Effects like add_to_variable / set_country_flag show no automatic tooltip in-game — type the text here and export auto-inserts custom_effect_tooltip into the effect block and ships the loc text.
qiuqiLibraryNotLoaded: Chinese modifier names aren't available right now.
cancelIfNotVisibleLabel: Cancel if not visible (ends the active-decision timer when the visible condition stops being true — no cancel_effect)
highlightStatesLabel: highlight_states (state IDs to highlight on hover)
highlightStatesHint: Comma-separated state IDs · highlighted on the map when hovering the decision. Exports as highlight_states → highlight_state_targets.
onMapModeHint: Where the decision's state icons appear while the menu is open
